subject: english
source: CISCE Curriculum for Primary Classes I-V (2016), official

covers: Tell a story or recount an experience with relevant facts
Give descriptive details, speaking clearly at a pace others can follow
Speak to an audience with suitable volume and pitch, and answer questions
Narrate stories and recite poems with expression, for enjoyment
Use correct grammar and specific words to give ideas and supporting details
Take part in drama and role play
Take dictation of short stories
Interpret a picture and ask questions that make them think critically
Read prose and poems aloud with fluency and expression
Write a paragraph of about 100 words with one central idea and a conclusion, using linking words such as 'because', 'and' and 'also'
Write personal, narrative or descriptive pieces from their own experience or real life
Write a simple letter to a parent, friend or relative
Understand subject and predicate, and what nouns, pronouns, verbs, adjectives and adverbs do in a sentence
Use collective and material nouns, and regular, irregular and plural nouns
Use simple past, present and future tenses
Use different kinds of adjectives, and 'a', 'an' and 'the' correctly
Put words in alphabetical order by their first two letters
Use glossaries and dictionaries, print and digital, to find word meanings
Show singular possession with an apostrophe, and tell plurals from possessives
Use prefixes, suffixes and vocabulary suited to their age
